'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is one of the playable classes in [[Erenshor]].

== Description ==
Bards use melee weapons and equip an instrument in their offhand. The class selection screen recommends Charisma and Dexterity. Charisma strengthens song damage and healing. Dexterity reduces a composed song's mana cost and the delay between different notes and chords.

== Songs ==
A Bard can play a note or chord on its own or add it to a song. {{AbilityLink|stablekey=skill:song - simple song}} holds two notes or chords, and {{AbilityLink|stablekey=skill:song - elrehonsong}} holds five. The order matters. {{AbilityLink|stablekey=skill:song - hum}} repeats one note or chord without spending mana. See {{ItemLink|stablekey=item:book - songwriting}} for the in-game instructions.
